commitResults.messageBody:
The template's placeholder name Duke (the Java mascot) is being replaced with Samantha, after the sentient AI in the movie Her.

Add Todos, Events, Deadlines as Tasks
Add test-ui skill for scripted console UI testing
commitResults.messageBody:
Adds a project skill that runs the console sessions described in
test/ui-test-plan.md against the compiled program and checks each
command's output against its expected output, stopping at the first
mismatch. Seeds the plan with test cases for the current commands
(greet/exit, todo, deadline, event, list, mark, unmark).

Also updates AGENTS.md so future code changes update the test plan
when needed and re-run this skill automatically, instead of relying
on manual spot-checking.

Introduces a checked SamanthaException, caught once user input an unexpected command. Covers: unrecognized commands, empty todo/deadline/event descriptions, deadlines/events missing their /by, /from, or /to markers, and mark/unmark with a missing, non-numeric, or out-of-range task number.

Also adds test cases (Test 5-7) to ui-test-plan.md covering these error paths, each interleaved with a valid follow-up command to check that a rejected input doesn't corrupt the task list state.
Following the AI Guidance on CS2103T website, Opus 5 is prompted to review the exisitng ui-test-plan.md. Added more corner cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Test: Drop OOPS prefix from expected outputs
commitResults.messageBody:
The error messages no longer carry an OOPSgit add test/ui-test-plan.md! prefix, but the test
plan still expected one, so 5 of the 9 test cases failed. Aligns the
expected blocks and the two test aims that described the prefix.

commitResults.messageTitle: Use dates and optional times for event and deadline
Enable query events occurring on a specific date
Extract console interaction boundary into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move response framing and fixed loading/farewell messages out of Samantha so user-facing console interaction has a single owner. Samantha now composes Storage and Ui while retaining command parsing and task operations, preserving every existing command response.

Introduce TaskList as the sole owner of the mutable task collection, with operations for loading, adding, looking up, removing, counting, and exposing an immutable persistence snapshot. Samantha now coordinates TaskList with Storage without directly holding a mutable List<Task>, preserving command behavior.

Move supported-command recognition and task-ID argument validation from Samantha into Parser. Samantha now delegates these command-language concerns while retaining command dispatch and task operations, preserving the existing commands and error messages.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move remaining command syntax parsing into Parser
commitResults.messageBody: Centralize raw command splitting, task-description extraction, deadline and event delimiter parsing, and list-date validation in Parser. Samantha now dispatches commands using parsed values while retaining task operations and persistence coordination, with all existing output preserved.

commitResults.messageTitle: Move console input handling into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Give Ui ownership of reading commands as well as presenting the welcome response. Samantha no longer depends on Scanner and remains focused on coordinating parsed commands, task operations, and persistence while preserving all existing console behavior.

Move startup, loading, command-loop, and shutdown orchestration from the static entry point into an instance run method. The main method now only creates Samantha and starts it, providing the lifecycle boundary needed for command-object dispatch without changing console behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Introduce command objects for exit and list
commitResults.messageBody: Add the Command execution contract and migrate the non-mutating bye and list operations into ExitCommand and ListCommand. This establishes execute and isExit behavior while retaining the existing dispatcher for commands not yet migrated.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task creation into command classes
commitResults.messageBody: Move todo, deadline, and event validation, task creation, persistence, and confirmations into dedicated command classes. Command now provides shared save and added-task helpers, reducing Samantha to command coordination while preserving all task-creation behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Extract task mutations into command classes
commitResults.messageBody: Move mark, unmark, and delete behavior into dedicated command classes and add shared task-ID validation to Command. Samantha no longer performs task mutations directly; it only invokes the selected command with the task list, UI, and storage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Parse commands directly into executable objects
commitResults.messageBody: Make Parser construct the appropriate Command subclass from a full user command and simplify Samantha.run to parse, execute, and inspect isExit. Add Ui.showError for the error path, yielding the intended polymorphic command loop without changing console output.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add specific parser and date-time exceptions
commitResults.messageBody: Replace generic SamanthaException instances in command parsing and date/time validation with named exception types for unsupported commands, missing markers or task IDs, invalid task IDs, extra arguments, missing date-time values, and invalid date-time formats. Preserve all existing user-facing messages so the refactor changes error semantics without changing command behavior.

Move task description and event-time validation into the task classes so commands no longer own task invariants. Add task-validation exceptions for empty descriptions, missing event endpoints, and invalid event times, and make TaskList responsible for one-based task lookup through TaskNotFoundException. Preserve all existing user-facing messages and command behavior.

Make Storage translate file-system failures into TaskFileReadException and TaskFileWriteException, and wrap malformed records in CorruptedTaskFileException with the affected line number. Use MalformedTaskRecordException for internal record-format failures and let Command delegate save errors directly to Storage. Preserve the existing corrupted-file, read-error, and save-error behavior at the UI boundary.

Make SamanthaException an abstract checked root and introduce InputException for parser and date-time validation failures. Move all input-related leaf exceptions under that category and narrow Parser, DateTimeValue, Deadline, and Event contracts to expose the appropriate exception families. Preserve command behavior and all existing user-facing messages.

Replace broad SamanthaException declarations on command execution methods with the specific task-validation, input, task-lookup, and task-file-write exception families each command can produce. Keep the abstract Command contract as the precise union required by all commands and retain the top-level Samantha catch as the application boundary.

Replace the remaining broad SamanthaException declarations on Storage's private parsing helpers with MalformedTaskRecordException, TaskValidationException, and InputException as appropriate. Keep Storage's public translation boundary unchanged while making internal failure responsibilities explicit.

Replace message-specific input and task leaf exceptions with broader InputException and TaskValidationException categories, while retaining distinct storage failures. Remove the obsolete exception classes and update callers and contracts without changing user-visible behavior.
Decompose SamanathaException into more detailed exceptions.
Move application classes under samantha subpackages for commands, model, parser, storage, UI, and exceptions. Update the UI test runner and setup documentation for the packaged entry point.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add SE-EDU Java coding standard skill
Align Java code with SE-EDU conventions

commitResults.messageBody: Git workflows need a shared standard for branch names and commit messages.\n\nDocument the SE-EDU rules so future project changes use consistent, focused, and reviewable history.

Project history needs consistent branch names and commit messages.\n\nRequire future authorized Git operations to apply the project-specific skill so commit subjects, bodies, and branch names follow the SE-EDU conventions.

The coding-standard branch conflicted with the JavaDoc changes in the
task model and related tests.

Keep the isDone() predicate API and preserve the existing descriptive
Javadocs so the model remains consistent with its callers and tests.

Level-9 adds a case-insensitive find command that preserves task
numbering and reports empty searches clearly.

Integrate the command, parser support, unit tests, and UI coverage into
master so task lookup is available alongside the existing commands.

Checkstyle was not configured in the Gradle build, so style rules were not enforced automatically.\n\nAdd the SE-EDU-aligned Checkstyle rules, test suppressions, and Gradle plugin configuration so checkstyleMain, checkstyleTest, and check can validate the project consistently.

Checkstyle reported indentation and lambda line-break violations in the existing code and tests.\n\nAdjust formatting in Parser, Storage, and affected tests so the new SE-EDU-aligned checks pass without changing behavior.

Samantha needs the tutorial-prescribed JavaFX runtime before the chat
interface can be introduced.

Add a cross-platform JavaFX launcher and make it the default Gradle
entry point so the application starts consistently on all supported OSes.

The console-only command API cannot supply replies to JavaFX controls.

Return command messages from the backend while retaining the console adapter,
then expose startup, response, and exit state through Samantha for the GUI.
Add focused tests without changing existing console command behaviour.

Samantha now needs a tutorial-shaped JavaFX view that can receive
commands and display backend responses.

Add the MainWindow and reusable DialogBox FXML controllers, classpath
avatars, shared Enter/Send handling, auto-scroll, and farewell shutdown.

The initial JavaFX window did not retain the approved framed
conversation design, leaving the conversation visually detached from the
mock-up.

Rebuild the FXML layout and CSS around an in-window keepsake frame,
with a clear title, framed cream conversation space, and a compact
composer. Use a portable PNG avatar and bounded message bubbles so the
conversation retains its two-person visual rhythm across platforms.

The conversation view could not load because the composer height was
declared as an AnchorPane constraint instead of a node property.

Declare the component height directly so JavaFX can parse the layout and
start the application.

Users need a concise way to discover the task commands and their
expected syntax without leaving Samantha.

Add a read-only help command that documents the supported operations
and date formats. Cover its parser integration and console output so the
guide remains accurate as command behavior evolves.
Add Samantha JavaFX GUI

commitResults.messageTitle: Parser: Use varargs for command token helpers
commitResults.messageBody:
Parser helpers require callers to pass a String array even when callers
already have individual tokens.

Accept token sequences as varargs while preserving existing array calls.
This makes the helper API simpler without changing parsing behavior.
